caribbean.headline: Roatan Heavy Rain, 23 kt Winds, 5.8 ft Seas
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing heavy tropical moisture with sustained winds near 23 kt, seas to 5.8 ft and an ENE dominant swell at an 8 s period, with 100% rain probability. I recommend mariners treat conditions as Small Craft Advisory level and secure small vessels, and I advise port authorities in Roatan and nearby Dominica, where winds reach 17 kt, to prepare for reduced visibility and localized runoff impacts.

mediterranean.headline: Small Craft Wind Risk Near Mykonos, Marseille Breezy
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing northeast winds up to 28 kt with wave heights to 6.6 ft and a dominant NNE swell at a 7 s period, and rain is less than 10% rain probability. I'm advising mariners that these conditions fall within the Small Craft Advisory range for exposed vessels while Marseille is breezy with winds near 23 kt, so secure loose gear and avoid unnecessary offshore transits.
